sections.changelog:
v:2.1.0 - 2026-11-01:
- Cryptographic Plugin Activity & Audit Logging Engine with unbroken SHA-256 chain, AES-256-GCM envelope encryption, and 7-day immutable checkpointing.
- Active Lockouts & Central Blocklist Forensics: Specific rule attribution, cryptographic incident tracking ID (WEBCARE-XXXXXXXX), live countdowns, and recent attack history drawer.
- Blocked & Whitelisted IPs Table Redesign: Phased out textareas in favor of structured, interactive tables with dedicated IP and Reason inputs, live search, and verified administrator authorization.
- High-Security 2FA Authentication: SHA-512 8-digit TOTP cryptographic algorithm support with backward compatibility for SHA-1.
- Native W3C WebAuthn Biometric Passkeys: Cryptographic signature verification, origin validation, and user presence enforcement for hardware FIDO2 and platform passkeys (Windows Hello, TouchID, FaceID).
